verdict.rationale: Manufact's docs describe per-item actions (deploy one server, view one deployment, run one checklist) and API/CLI access for scripting, but nowhere is there evidence of a bulk operation capability (e.g., bulk deploy, bulk delete, or batch update across many servers/deployments at once). The MCP tool exposure (manufact-docs-14/31) lets an agent manage 'everything' but only as individual tool calls, not a documented bulk-action feature.
